records.question: Write a function to calculate whether the matrix is a magic square.
records.trace:
def is_magic_square(matrix):
    n = len(matrix)
    expected_sum = sum(matrix[0])
    rows = [sum(row) for row in matrix]
    cols = [sum(col) for col in zip(*matrix)]
    diagonals = [sum(matrix[i][i] for i in range(n)), sum(matrix[i][n - i - 1] for i in range(n))]
    return all(sum_ == expected_sum for sum_ in rows + cols + diagonals)

    n = len(matrix)
    expected_sum = sum(matrix[0])
    rows = [sum(row) for row in matrix]
    cols = [sum(col) for col in zip(*matrix)]
    diagonals = [sum(matrix[i][i] for i in range(n)), sum(matrix[i][n - i - 1] for i in range(n))]
    return all(sum_ == expected_sum for sum_ in rows + cols + diagonals)
